# Credits

<!-- Generated by `npx tsx scripts/licences.ts --credits` from app/src/about/credits.ts. Do not edit by hand. -->

OPTCG Sim is an unofficial, non-commercial fan tool, not affiliated with or endorsed by Bandai, Shueisha, or Toei Animation. One Piece and all card names, text, and art belong to their respective owners.

Licence: to be chosen by the owner.

## optcgapi.com

https://optcgapi.com/documentation

Card data (names, costs, powers, effect text) and the card images, which your browser loads from optcgapi.com while you play. Every image is its scan with the SAMPLE watermark. If an image does not load, the app tries the next source, then draws the card as text.

Terms: It describes its data as open for anyone to use. Images are shown from its servers and never copied into this project.

## arjunkai optcg-api

https://github.com/arjunkai/optcg-api

A second image source in the fallback order. It is switched off, so nothing is requested from it.

Terms: It stays off until its maintainer approves third-party use.

## Limitless

https://onepiece.limitlesstcg.com

Tournament decklists and play rates from the Limitless Play public API, and card text from its card pages: the data of OP-18 until optcgapi.com has the set (those cards show as text, with no image), and a cross-check for the rest.

Terms: Its developer documentation asks for no key for public reads and sets no attribution rule; it is credited here anyway, and it is read slowly and cached.

## opmetagame

https://opmetagame.com

The tier labels in the deck guides, cited by name and date.

Terms: Its robots.txt allows reading; only the labels are used, never its pages.

## Shonen TCG

https://www.shonentcg.com

Deck guides and strategy articles, cited by title and date in each guide and lesson. Our guides are paraphrase and our own examples, not copies.

Terms: Its robots.txt allows reading, including by AI agents; no article text is reproduced.

## Bounty TCG

https://www.bountytcg.app

Strategy articles on turn order and attacking, cited by title and date where a lesson uses them.

Terms: Its robots.txt allows reading, including by AI agents; no article text is reproduced.

## Haki TCG and TCGplayer

https://hakitcg.com

A battle-maths example and the tournament write-ups cited in the meta notes, named where they are used.

Terms: Haki TCG allows reading. TCGplayer was not fetched by this project; its articles are cited by link and never reproduced.

## The One Piece Card Game Comprehensive Rules

https://en.onepiece-cardgame.com/rules/

The rules the engine implements, version 1.2.1. The rule explanations here are our paraphrase; the official text is Bandai’s.

Terms: The official site’s terms do not allow bulk reproduction of its text, so none is copied; rules are cited by number.
